description: Puts the pointer on an element and returns a screenshot of what that reveals: dropdowns, tooltips, hover styling. These states cannot be reached any other way: a synthetic event fires the page handlers but leaves the CSS untouched, so this uses a real pointer move. Nothing is clicked.

element.description: A number from the most recent annotate_interactive on this tab. Easier and safer than retyping a selector.

name: hover
title: Hover and photograph
